name: ai-demo-workspace
description: AI learning notes and runnable demo projects

scripts.format: npm run format:markdown && npm run format:python
scripts.format:python: cd projects/python && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: npm run format:markdown:check && npm run format:python:check
scripts.format:python:check: cd projects/python && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: cd projects/python && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:python:fix: cd projects/python && uv run ruff check --fix .
